description: This PHP source file defines the "Zend_Loader_PluginLoader" class, which implements a plugin class loader for the Zend Framework. It manages plugin paths, class loading, caching, and registry handling, supporting dynamic and static registry modes.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_PluginLoader
classes.description: A class loader for Zend Framework plugins, supporting dynamic and static plugin path registration, plugin loading, caching, and class registry management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin loader with optional prefix-to-path mappings and a static registry name.

methods.name: _formatPrefix
methods.description: Ensures the prefix string ends with an underscore and is correctly formatted for internal use.

methods.name: addPrefixPath
methods.description: Registers a new prefix and path for plugin class lookup, supporting both static and instance registries.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves registered paths for a given prefix or all paths if no prefix is specified.

methods.name: clearPaths
methods.description: Clears path registration for a specific prefix or all prefixes.

methods.name: removePrefixPath
methods.description: Removes a registered prefix and optional path from the registry.

methods.name: _formatName
methods.description: Normalizes a plugin name by capitalizing the first letter.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a plugin with a given name is already loaded.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with a plugin, if loaded.

methods.name: getClassPath
methods.description: Returns the file path of the plugin class, if loaded.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load a plugin class by name, including files from registered paths, and registers it if successful.

methods.name: setIncludeFileCache
methods.description: Sets a cache file path for storing include_once statements for plugin classes.

methods.name: getIncludeFileCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache file path for plugin class includes.

methods.name: _appendIncFile
methods.description: Appends an include_once statement to the cache file for a new plugin class file.
